candidates.venue: Pig Iron Theatre Company
candidates.description:
Rat With Wings or Bird Of Peace? COLUMBO'S DAY is the etymological exploitation of all things “Colombian” as a multi-character one-clown show with a couple crappy puppets, a broken record player, and stuff being knocked off pedestals. Starring Howard Zinn as Lieutenant Columbo, Christopher Columbus as Morrissey, and An Ordinary Pigeon as Noah’s Dove.
